thread:
maya: Quick check before we flip the staging gate for model aurora-7b-q4 — are weights fully uploaded and tokenizer validated? planning a small EU canary tomorrow.

sam: Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/aurora/aurora-7b-q4/weights.tar.gz
sam: sha256: 3f7a...c8e (matches release manifest)

jin: Tokenizer note: there's an emoji-split edge case on sequences with leading ZWJ + regional indicators — seen off-by-one with prefix cache. Recommend enabling `hybrid_split: true` in tokenizer config for this variant.

priya: @jin thanks — can you paste the minimal config change? also we need the catalog entry pin + fallback variant name for ops.

jin: Sure — add to model config:
```
model_version: "v2.1-aurora-q4"
serve_pin: "aurora-7b-q4-v2.1"
fallback: "aurora-7b-quant-fallback"
tokenizer:
  hybrid_split: true
```

jin: Also note recommended max_cache_kv_bytes: 64MB for q4 quant to avoid GC spikes.

maya: @sam @priya can we enable a tiny EU-west canary (5% traffic) for 2 hours after deploy? want to validate latency + tokenization behavior before global.

sam: Yes. infra changes in PR 5421, added traffic-split toggle `catalog.canaries.aurora_eu` — currently set to 0. I'll bump to 0.05 post-deploy and monitor.

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline updated: staging -> aurora-7b-q4 -> running checks. Canary window scheduled at 2026-03-18T09:00Z for 2h. See CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/5421

aaron: pinging for review on PR 5421 (infra), left one small comment about region tag. @priya could you take a look when free?

priya: On it. I'll validate the catalog schema against the UI toggles and confirm logging keys for per-route cost breakdown.

maya: Awesome. If tokenizer hybrid_split change looks good on canary, we can flip staging gate and roll to dedicated after SLA checks. Thanks team :thumbsup:

sam: I'll watch memory and latency graphs during the window. If anything >15% regression, we'll rollback automatically (fallback configured).

jin: If you see tokenization mismatches, use `--tokenize-debug` on a failing request and DM me logs.

maya: Great — closing async loop here. Will post results in the morning. :coffee:
